name: Olectra Greentech Ltd
about: Olectra Greentech Limited was incorporated in 2000 . The Company is primarily engaged in the manufacturing of composite polymer insulators and electrical buses. Its registered office is in Hyderabad. [1] [2]
key_points: Business Segments [1] a) Mobility Division (86% in Q1 FY27 vs 84% in Q1 FY26): [2] [3] [4] The company is India’s largest pure-play electric bus manufacturer, with an estimated 20%+ market share, and was the first company to launch electric buses in India. It has 4,000+ vehicles on the road, covering 700 Mn+ green kilometres. The company offers 7-metre, 9-metre and 12-metre electric buses for intra-city and inter-city applications, along with electric coaches and tippers, with driving ranges of 200-350+ km. Its customer base includes TSRTC, KSRTC, GMR-Airport, Microsoft, Fresh Bus and MSRTC , among others. The company sold 1,280 EVs in FY26, up from 972 in FY25. profile.summary: Olectra Greentech Limited manufactures and sells electric buses and trucks in India. It operates in two segments, Energy Division and Mobility Division. The company offers electric tippers. It also provides 1200KV, 330-420KV, 220-245KV, 110-132KV, 52-77KV, 33-36KV, 22-28KV, and 10-15KV composite polymer insulators for transmission and distribution; and tonne, bracket tube, and stay arm insulators for railways. The company serves state and central government bodies, and power generation and distribution utilities; private power generation companies; and multinational infrastructure companies. The company was formerly known as Goldstone Infratech Limited and changed its name to Olectra Greentech Limited in July 2018. Olectra Greentech Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
